review.alternative: Epistemology may be entirely pragmatic rather than truth-oriented.

claims.statement: Epistemology historically seeks to understand how knowledge is justified, structured, and constrained by evidence.

support.explanation: Defines the role of evidence in constraining rational confidence.
support.passage: Much recent work in formal epistemology is an attempt to understand how our degrees of confidence are rationally constrained by our evidence

review.alternative: Verification can occur implicitly through performance optimization without dedicated falsification roles.

claims.statement: AI-Generated Science systems can incorporate explicit falsification agents to verify scientific discoveries.

support.explanation: Demonstrates the integration of explicit falsification agents in automated discovery.
support.passage: By introducing FalsificationAgent, which identify and then verify possible scientific discoveries, we empower the system with explicit falsification.
